name: Freisa d'Asti
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Piedmont wine made from at least 90% Freisa, from the hills of Asti province. Its rules allow still, semi-sparkling and sparkling wine.
